definition: The Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) [ˈɒnɪks] is an open-source artificial intelligence ecosystem of technology companies and research organizations that establish open standards for representing machine learning algorithms and software tools to enable a standard format for representing machine learning models.

explainer.lead: How to install ONNX, a first working example, and where it fits in an AI project.
explainer.createdBy: Microsoft and Facebook (Meta); Linux Foundation AI & Data.

quickstart.python:
import torch
import onnx

model = torch.nn.Linear(4, 2)
torch.onnx.export(model, torch.randn(1, 4), "linear.onnx",
                  input_names=["x"], output_names=["y"])
onnx.checker.check_model(onnx.load("linear.onnx"))
print("valid ONNX model")

explainer.inAi: Export once, then deploy to servers, browsers, phones or edge devices with ONNX Runtime, TensorRT or OpenVINO.
explainer.jsNote: You do not need the onnx package in JavaScript; load .onnx files with onnxruntime-web or onnxruntime-node (see ONNX Runtime).
